<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27 viewBox=%270 0 32 32%27%3E%3Ctext y=%2726%27 font-size=%2726%27%3E%E2%AD%90%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E">
<title>Happy Birthday, Pim</title>
<style>
:root{
  --ink:#1d3a6b; --blue:#4a86c8; --sky:#bcdcf5; --paper:#f6faff; --tape:rgba(150,200,240,.62);
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.65,0,.25,1);
  --mono:'Courier New',ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;
  --hand:'Segoe Script','Bradley Hand','Snell Roundhand','Noteworthy','Comic Sans MS',cursive;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html,body{height:100%;margin:0;overflow:hidden;overscroll-behavior:none}
body{
  background:#cfe4f5 url("data:image/jpeg;base64,") center/cover no-repeat fixed;
  font-family:var(--mono);color:var(--ink);user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;
}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:0;background:none;padding:0}
button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #fff;outline-offset:2px;box-shadow:0 0 0 5px var(--blue)}

/* ---------- stage / book ---------- */
.stage{position:fixed;inset:0}
.scaler{
  position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:1000px;height:1414px;margin:-707px 0 0 -500px;
  transform-origin:50% 50%;transition:transform 1.15s var(--ease);will-change:transform;
}
.no-anim .scaler,.no-anim .leaf{transition:none!important}
.book{position:absolute;inset:0;perspective:3400px}
.page{position:absolute;top:0;width:1000px;height:707px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper);
  box-shadow:0 24px 50px rgba(18,52,110,.34),0 3px 8px rgba(18,52,110,.2)}
.page .pg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;object-fit:cover;
  -webkit-user-drag:none;pointer-events:none}
#pageL{left:0;top:0;border-radius:8px 8px 0 0;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;
  transition:opacity .3s .5s,visibility 0s .9s}
.open #pageL{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transition:opacity .3s .55s,visibility 0s .55s}
#pageR{left:0;top:707px;border-radius:0 0 8px 8px}
.spine{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;height:70px;pointer-events:none}
#pageL .spine{bottom:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(20,50,110,0),rgba(20,50,110,.22))}
#pageR .spine{top:0;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(20,50,110,0),rgba(20,50,110,.22))}

.leaf{position:absolute;left:0;top:707px;width:1000px;height:707px;transform-origin:50% 0;
  transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:transform 1.15s var(--ease);z-index:5;cursor:pointer;
  border-radius:0 0 8px 8px}
.open .leaf{transform:rotateX(180deg)}
.leaf.gone{visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.face{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;backface-visibility:hidden;-webkit-backface-visibility:hidden;
  box-shadow:0 24px 50px rgba(18,52,110,.34),0 3px 8px rgba(18,52,110,.2)}
.face img{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;object-fit:cover;pointer-events:none;-webkit-user-drag:none}
.face.front{border-radius:0 0 8px 8px}
.face.back{transform:rotateX(180deg);border-radius:8px 8px 0 0}
.face .spine{pointer-events:none}
.face.front .spine{top:0;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(20,50,110,0),rgba(20,50,110,.28))}
.face.back .spine{bottom:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(20,50,110,0),rgba(20,50,110,.22))}
.leaf-hit{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:2;background:none;width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:inherit}
.tap-hint{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.14em;
  color:var(--ink);text-transform:lowercase;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .4s;
  text-shadow:0 0 8px #fff,0 0 3px #fff}
.tap-hint span{display:inline-block;background:rgba(246,250,255,.82);padding:6px 16px;border-radius:99px;
  border:1.5px dashed rgba(29,58,107,.5);animation:bob 2.2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes bob{50%{transform:translateY(-4px)}}
body.open .tap-hint{opacity:0}

/* ---------- hotspots on the left page ---------- */
.hot{position:absolute;background:none;border-radius:14px}
.hot-letter{left:1.2%;top:2.5%;width:22.5%;height:17.5%}
.hot-ring{position:absolute;left:3.5%;top:13.9%;width:18.2%;height:4.8%;border-radius:999px;pointer-events:none;
  border:3px solid rgba(74,134,200,.9);animation:ring 1.8s ease-out infinite}
@keyframes ring{0%{transform:scale(1);opacity:.9}100%{transform:scale(1.28,1.7);opacity:0}}

/* ---------- letter modal ---------- */
.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:30;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  background:rgba(22,48,96,.38);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(3px);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);
  opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .35s,visibility 0s .35s}
.modal.show{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transition:opacity .35s}
.sheet{position:relative;width:min(92vw,calc((100vh - 56px) * 1.775));aspect-ratio:1724/971;
  transform:scale(.82) rotate(-2deg);transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2);
  box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(10,30,70,.5);border-radius:6px;background:var(--paper)}
.modal.show .sheet{transform:none}
.sheet img{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;border-radius:6px;pointer-events:none}
.sheet .home{left:82.1%;top:75.2%;width:8.1%;height:14.4%;border-radius:50%;position:absolute}

/* ---------- cake page ---------- */
.fl{position:absolute;transition:opacity .35s ease,transform .45s ease;pointer-events:none}
.fl .fi{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;transform-origin:var(--ox) var(--oy);
  pointer-events:none;-webkit-user-drag:none}
.fl.out{opacity:0;transform:scale(.15) translateY(-6%);transform-origin:var(--ox) var(--oy)}
.fl.pop{animation:pop .6s cubic-bezier(.2,1.6,.4,1)}
@keyframes pop{0%{opacity:0;transform:scale(.2)}100%{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.smoke{position:absolute;width:0;height:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:4}
.smoke i{position:absolute;left:-9px;top:-9px;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(110,140,185,.7),rgba(110,140,185,0) 70%);opacity:0;filter:blur(2px)}
.smoke.go i{animation:puff 1.8s ease-out forwards}
.smoke.go i:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.18s;left:-3px}
.smoke.go i:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.36s;left:-14px}
@keyframes puff{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(0,0) scale(.4)}20%{opacity:.85}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(16px,-110px) scale(3)}}
.pill-hit{position:absolute;left:28.3%;top:87.2%;width:38.1%;height:9.5%;border-radius:999px;background:none}

.wish{position:absolute;left:50%;top:5%;z-index:6;padding:20px 46px 22px;text-align:center;
  background:#fffaf1;color:var(--ink);transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(-3deg) scale(.5);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;
  transition:opacity .4s,transform .6s cubic-bezier(.2,1.5,.4,1);
  clip-path:polygon(0 4%,5% 0,12% 3%,22% 0,34% 4%,47% 0,60% 3%,73% 0,86% 4%,95% 0,100% 5%,98% 30%,100% 55%,97% 80%,100% 96%,92% 100%,80% 96%,66% 100%,52% 96%,38% 100%,24% 96%,10% 100%,3% 97%,0 90%,2% 62%,0 35%);
  filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 14px rgba(20,50,110,.35))}
.wish.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(-3deg) scale(1)}
.wish b{display:block;font:400 34px/1.1 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}
.wish em{display:block;font:400 82px/1.1 var(--hand);color:var(--blue);font-style:normal;margin-top:4px}
.wish::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;width:130px;height:34px;margin-left:-65px;
  background:var(--tape);transform:rotate(2deg)}

/* ---------- HUD ---------- */
.hud{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));z-index:20;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;
  justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:10px 12px;padding:0 10px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;
  transition:opacity .4s}
.hud.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transition:opacity .4s .9s}
.chip{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 16px;font-size:14px;
  letter-spacing:.06em;background:rgba(246,250,255,.92);border:1.5px dashed rgba(29,58,107,.55);border-radius:10px;
  box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(20,50,110,.22);transition:transform .15s,background .15s}
.chip::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:-9px;width:44px;height:15px;margin-left:-22px;background:var(--tape);
  transform:rotate(-3deg);border-radius:2px;pointer-events:none}
.chip:nth-child(even)::before{transform:rotate(3deg)}
button.chip:hover{background:#fff;transform:translateY(-2px) rotate(-1deg)}
button.chip:active,button.chip.held{transform:scale(.96);background:#e3f1ff}
.chip[hidden]{display:none}
.chip.primary{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;border-style:solid;border-color:#fff}
.meter{display:flex;gap:3px;align-items:flex-end;height:20px}
.meter i{width:5px;height:4px;border-radius:2px;background:rgba(29,58,107,.2);transition:height .06s,background .06s}
.meter i.on{background:var(--blue)}
.meter i.hot{background:#ff8a5c}
.mic-status{font-size:12px;opacity:.8;min-width:5.5em}
.rotate-tip{display:none;width:100%;text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink);text-shadow:0 0 6px #fff}
@media (orientation:portrait) and (max-width:700px){.rotate-tip.on{display:block}}
#confetti{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:40;pointer-events:none}
.sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0)}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.scaler,.leaf{transition-duration:.01s!important}.tap-hint span,.hot-ring{animation:none}}

/* ---------- shown instead of the card when scripts can't run (e.g. file previews on iPad) ---------- */
.nojs{display:none}
html:not(.js) .stage,html:not(.js) .tap-hint,html:not(.js) .hud,html:not(.js) .modal{display:none}
html:not(.js) .nojs{position:fixed;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:18px;padding:16px}
.nojs img{display:block;max-width:92vw;max-height:68vh;width:auto;height:auto;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 24px 50px rgba(18,52,110,.34)}
.nojs p{margin:0;max-width:34em;text-align:center;font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;padding:10px 18px;background:rgba(246,250,255,.92);
  border:1.5px dashed rgba(29,58,107,.55);border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(20,50,110,.22)}
</style>
</head>
<body class="no-anim">
<script>document.documentElement.classList.add("js")</script>
<div class="nojs"><img alt="Birthday card cover" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"><p>This preview can't run the interactive card.<br>Open this file in Safari or Chrome (or use the card's web link) to open it.</p></div>

<div class="stage" id="stage">
  <div class="scaler" id="scaler">
    <div class="book" id="book">

      <!-- left page: envelope / "click here" -->
      <section class="page" id="pageL" aria-label="Left page: a letter for you">
        <img class="pg" alt="Scrapbook page with an envelope that says click here" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,">
        <span class="hot-ring"></span>
        <button class="hot hot-letter" id="openLetter" aria-label="Click here to read your letter"></button>
        <div class="spine"></div>
      </section>

      <!-- right page: cake -->
      <section class="page" id="pageR" aria-label="Right page: birthday cake">
        <img class="pg" alt="Cake with candles" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,">
        <div class="fl" id="flame1" style="left:65.150%;top:33.239%;width:4.250%;height:12.306%;--ox:52%;--oy:84%"><img class="fi" alt="" src="data:image/png;base64,"></div><div class="smoke" style="left:67.360%;top:43.576%"><i></i><i></i><i></i></div>
<div class="fl" id="flame2" style="left:76.400%;top:33.239%;width:5.600%;height:12.588%;--ox:31%;--oy:83%"><img class="fi" alt="" src="data:image/png;base64,"></div><div class="smoke" style="left:78.136%;top:43.687%"><i></i><i></i><i></i></div>

        <button class="pill-hit" id="pillHit" aria-label="Blow the candles"></button>
        <div class="wish" id="wish" role="status"><b>Make a wish,</b><em id="wishName">Pim</em></div>
        <div class="spine"></div>
      </section>

      <!-- cover: hinged on the centre line, flips onto the left -->
      <div class="leaf" id="leaf">
        <div class="face front">
          <img alt="Birthday card cover" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,">
          <div class="spine"></div>
          <button class="leaf-hit" id="coverBtn" aria-label="Open the card"></button>
        </div>
        <div class="face back">
          <img alt="" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,">
          <div class="spine"></div>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="tap-hint" id="tapHint"><span>tap the cover to open &#9825;</span></div>

<!-- letter modal -->
<div class="modal" id="letter" aria-hidden="true" role="dialog" aria-label="Your letter">
  <div class="sheet">
    <img alt="Your birthday letter" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,">
    <button class="home" id="closeLetter" aria-label="Close letter (home)"></button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- controls -->
<div class="hud" id="hud">
    <button class="chip" id="backBtn">&larr; Back to Cover</button>
  <button class="chip" id="soundBtn" aria-pressed="false"><span aria-hidden="true">&#9834;</span><span id="soundLabel">Sound</span></button>
  <button class="chip" id="micBtn" aria-pressed="false"><span aria-hidden="true">&#127908;</span><span id="micLabel">Use mic</span></button>
  <div class="chip" aria-label="Microphone level"><div class="meter" id="meter" role="img" aria-label="level"></div><span class="mic-status" id="micStatus">mic off</span></div>
  <button class="chip" id="blowBtn" title="Hold to blow (or hold Space)">&#128168; Blow <small>(hold / Space)</small></button>
  <button class="chip primary" id="relightBtn" hidden>&#128367; Relight</button>
</div>

<audio id="bgm" preload="auto" src="data:audio/mpeg;base64,"></audio>
<canvas id="confetti" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
<div class="sr" id="live" aria-live="polite"></div>

<script>
(() => {
'use strict';

/* ================= settings you may tweak ================= */
const NAME = 'Pim';                // shown in "Make a wish, ___"
const BLOW_TIME = [0.50, 0.62];    // seconds of blowing needed to put out flame 1 / flame 2
const MIN_THRESHOLD = 0.06;        // lower = more sensitive microphone (RMS 0..1)
const NOISE_MULT = 3.5;            // blow must exceed ambient noise x this
const MAX_LEAN = 42;               // degrees the flame leans when blown hard
/* ========================================================== */

const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const body = document.body, stage = $('stage'), scaler = $('scaler'), leaf = $('leaf'), hud = $('hud');
const flames = [...document.querySelectorAll('.fl')];
$('wishName').textContent = NAME;
document.title = 'Happy Birthday, ' + NAME;

/* ---------------- layout (scale to viewport) ---------------- */
let isOpen = false;
function viewportSize(){
  const ok = n => typeof n === 'number' && isFinite(n) && n > 50;
  const de = document.documentElement, vv = window.visualViewport;
  const cands = [[stage.clientWidth, stage.clientHeight], [innerWidth, innerHeight], [de.clientWidth, de.clientHeight],
                 [vv && vv.width, vv && vv.height], [screen.width, screen.height]];
  for (const [w, h] of cands) if (ok(w) && ok(h)) return [w, h];
  return [1024, 768];
}
function layout(animate){
  const [vw, vh] = viewportSize();
  let s, ty = 0;
  if (isOpen){
    const reserve = (hud.offsetHeight || 60) + 14 + 14, topPad = 14;     // keep the card clear of the controls
    const avail = Math.max(120, vh - reserve - topPad);
    s = Math.min(vw * 0.94 / 1000, avail / 1414);
    ty = topPad + avail / 2 - vh / 2;
  } else {
    const gap = Math.max(28, vh * 0.07);
    s = Math.min(vw * 0.9 / 1000, (vh - gap * 2 - 40) / 707);
    ty = -353.5 * s;                     // cover is the lower half -> centre it
  }
  if (!isFinite(s)) s = 0.5;
  s = Math.max(s, 0.08);
  // resizing never animates; only opening/closing the card does
  const quiet = animate !== true && !busy;
  if (quiet) body.classList.add('no-anim');
  scaler.style.transform = `translate(0px,${ty}px) scale(${s})`;
  if (quiet){ void scaler.offsetWidth; requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => { if (!busy) body.classList.remove('no-anim'); })); setTimeout(() => { if (!busy) body.classList.remove('no-anim'); }, 120); }
  const hint = $('tapHint');
  hint.style.top = (vh / 2 + 353.5 * s + 14) + 'px';
}
const relayout = () => layout();
addEventListener('resize', relayout);
addEventListener('orientationchange', () => { relayout(); setTimeout(relayout, 250); });
addEventListener('pageshow', relayout);
addEventListener('load', relayout);
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', relayout);
if (window.visualViewport) window.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize', relayout);
if (window.ResizeObserver){ const ro = new ResizeObserver(relayout); ro.observe(document.documentElement); ro.observe(hud); }
let busy = false;
layout();
// the page may be measured before its frame has its final size: measure again a few times
[60, 250, 700, 1500, 3000].forEach(ms => setTimeout(relayout, ms));

/* ---------------- sound ---------------- */
const bgm = $('bgm');
function soundUI(){ const on = !bgm.paused && !bgm.ended; $('soundBtn').setAttribute('aria-pressed', on); $('soundLabel').textContent = on ? 'Sound on' : 'Sound off'; }
['play','pause','ended'].forEach(ev => bgm.addEventListener(ev, soundUI));
let userPaused = false;
$('soundBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (bgm.paused || bgm.ended){ userPaused = false; if (bgm.ended) bgm.currentTime = 0; bgm.play().catch(() => {}); }
  else { userPaused = true; bgm.pause(); }
});
soundUI();
// start as soon as the page opens; browsers often block that until the first touch/click, so retry then
function tryPlay(){ if (userPaused || !bgm.paused || bgm.ended) return Promise.resolve(); return bgm.play().catch(() => { armFirstTouch(); }); }
let armed = false;
function armFirstTouch(){
  if (armed) return; armed = true;
  const go = () => { ['pointerdown','touchend','click','keydown'].forEach(e => removeEventListener(e, go, true)); armed = false; tryPlay(); };
  ['pointerdown','touchend','click','keydown'].forEach(e => addEventListener(e, go, true));
}
tryPlay();

/* ---------------- open / close card ---------------- */
let closeTimer = 0;
const FLIP_MS = 1200;
function openCard(){
  if (busy || isOpen) return;
  busy = true; isOpen = true;
  clearTimeout(closeTimer);
  leaf.classList.remove('gone');
  body.classList.add('open');
  scaler.classList.add('open');            // for CSS descendant selectors
  body.classList.remove('no-anim'); layout(true);
  hud.classList.add('show');
  tryPlay();
  setTimeout(() => { leaf.classList.add('gone'); busy = false; }, FLIP_MS);
}
function closeCard(){
  if (busy || !isOpen) return;
  busy = true;
  closeLetter(true);
  stopMic();
  relight(true);
  isOpen = false;
  hud.classList.remove('show');
  leaf.classList.remove('gone');
  void leaf.offsetWidth;                   // commit visibility before animating back
  body.classList.remove('open');
  scaler.classList.remove('open');
  body.classList.remove('no-anim'); layout(true);
  setTimeout(() => { busy = false; }, FLIP_MS);
}
// the CSS uses `.open` on an ancestor of #pageL / .leaf -> put it on the scaler too
$('coverBtn').addEventListener('click', openCard);
$('backBtn').addEventListener('click', closeCard);

/* ---------------- letter ---------------- */
const letterEl = $('letter');
let letterOpen = false;
function openLetter(){ letterOpen = true; letterEl.classList.add('show'); letterEl.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false'); }
function closeLetter(silent){
  if (!letterOpen) return;
  letterOpen = false; letterEl.classList.remove('show'); letterEl.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
}
$('openLetter').addEventListener('click', openLetter);
$('closeLetter').addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); closeLetter(); });
letterEl.addEventListener('click', e => { if (e.target === letterEl) closeLetter(); });

/* ---------------- flames ---------------- */
const F = flames.map((el, i) => ({
  el, fi: el.querySelector('.fi'), smoke: el.nextElementSibling, lit: true, acc: 0, lean: 0,
  need: BLOW_TIME[i] ?? 0.55, phase: i * 2.3 + 0.7, dir: 1
}));
let wishShown = false;

function updateRelightBtn(){ $('relightBtn').hidden = !F.some(f => !f.lit); }
function extinguish(f){
  f.lit = false; f.el.classList.remove('pop'); f.el.classList.add('out');
  f.smoke.classList.remove('go'); void f.smoke.offsetWidth; f.smoke.classList.add('go');
  updateRelightBtn();
  if (F.every(x => !x.lit)) allOut();
}
function relight(silent){
  F.forEach((f, i) => {
    if (f.lit && !silent) return;
    f.lit = true; f.acc = 0; f.lean = 0;
    f.el.classList.remove('out'); f.smoke.classList.remove('go'); f.fi.style.transform = '';
    if (!silent){ void f.el.offsetWidth; setTimeout(() => f.el.classList.add('pop'), i * 140); setTimeout(() => f.el.classList.remove('pop'), 900 + i*140); }
  });
  wishShown = false; $('wish').classList.remove('show');
  stopConfetti(); updateRelightBtn();
}
$('relightBtn').addEventListener('click', () => relight(false));

function allOut(){
  if (wishShown) return;
  wishShown = true;
  $('wish').classList.add('show');
  $('live').textContent = 'Make a wish, ' + NAME;
  burstConfetti();
}

/* ---------------- blow input (mic + manual) ---------------- */
let micOn = false, micLevel = 0, micBlowing = false, lastLoud = 0;
let manualHeld = false, manualMinUntil = 0;
let noiseFloor = 0.008, calibFrames = 0;
let ctx = null, analyser = null, stream = null, td = null, fd = null;
const meter = $('meter');
for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) meter.appendChild(document.createElement('i'));
const bars = [...meter.children];
function setMeter(v){
  const n = Math.round(Math.min(1, v) * bars.length);
  bars.forEach((b, i) => {
    b.className = i < n ? (i > bars.length * 0.7 ? 'on hot' : 'on') : '';
    b.style.height = (4 + (i / bars.length) * 16) + 'px';
  });
}
setMeter(0);
function status(t){ $('micStatus').textContent = t; }

async function startMic(){
  if (micOn) return true;
  if (!navigator.mediaDevices || !navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia){
    status('no mic (needs https)'); return false;
  }
  try{
    stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({audio:{echoCancellation:false,noiseSuppression:false,autoGainControl:false}});
    const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    ctx = new AC();
    if (ctx.state === 'suspended') await ctx.resume();
    const src = ctx.createMediaStreamSource(stream);
    const hp = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); hp.type = 'highpass'; hp.frequency.value = 60;
    analyser = ctx.createAnalyser(); analyser.fftSize = 1024; analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.2;
    src.connect(hp); hp.connect(analyser);
    td = new Float32Array(analyser.fftSize); fd = new Float32Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);
    micOn = true; calibFrames = 0; noiseFloor = 0.008;
    bgm.pause();            // the speakers would otherwise be heard as blowing
    $('micBtn').setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true'); $('micLabel').textContent = 'Mic on';
    status('listening…');
    return true;
  }catch(err){
    status(err && err.name === 'NotAllowedError' ? 'mic blocked - use Blow' : 'no mic - use Blow');
    return false;
  }
}
function stopMic(){
  if (stream){ stream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop()); stream = null; }
  if (ctx){ try{ ctx.close(); }catch(e){} ctx = null; }
  micOn = false; micBlowing = false; micLevel = 0; analyser = null;
  $('micBtn').setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false'); $('micLabel').textContent = 'Use mic';
  status('mic off'); setMeter(0);
}
$('micBtn').addEventListener('click', () => { micOn ? stopMic() : startMic(); });

// read the mic: returns {level 0..1 for the meter, rms, blowing}
function readMic(now){
  analyser.getFloatTimeDomainData(td);
  let sum = 0; for (let i = 0; i < td.length; i++) sum += td[i] * td[i];
  const rms = Math.sqrt(sum / td.length);
  // low-frequency share: a breath is mostly rumble/noise below ~1.5 kHz
  analyser.getFloatFrequencyData(fd);
  const binHz = ctx.sampleRate / analyser.fftSize;
  const cut = Math.min(fd.length, Math.round(1500 / binHz));
  let lo = 0, all = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < fd.length; i++){ const m = Math.pow(10, Math.max(fd[i], -140) / 10); all += m; if (i < cut) lo += m; }
  const lowShare = all > 0 ? lo / all : 0;

  const thr = Math.max(MIN_THRESHOLD, noiseFloor * NOISE_MULT);
  calibFrames++;
  const loud = rms > (micBlowing ? thr * 0.6 : thr) && (lowShare > 0.45 || rms > thr * 3);
  if (loud) lastLoud = now;
  micBlowing = loud || (now - lastLoud < 90 && micBlowing);   // tiny hold so brief dips don't reset
  if (!micBlowing && rms < thr) noiseFloor = noiseFloor * 0.97 + rms * 0.03;
  const db = 20 * Math.log10(Math.max(rms, 1e-5));
  micLevel = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (db + 56) / 44));
  const strength = micBlowing ? Math.max(0.35, Math.min(1, (rms - thr * 0.6) / 0.22 + 0.35)) : 0;
  return {rms, strength};
}

/* manual (button / space) – a tap still gives a ~0.8s puff */
function manualStart(){ if (!manualHeld){ manualHeld = true; manualMinUntil = performance.now() + 800; $('blowBtn').classList.add('held'); } }
function manualStop(){ manualHeld = false; $('blowBtn').classList.remove('held'); }
const blowBtn = $('blowBtn');
blowBtn.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => { e.preventDefault(); try{ blowBtn.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); }catch(_){} manualStart(); });
['pointerup','pointercancel','lostpointercapture'].forEach(t => blowBtn.addEventListener(t, manualStop));
blowBtn.addEventListener('click', e => { if (e.detail === 0){ manualStart(); setTimeout(manualStop, 50); } });
addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.code !== 'Space' || !isOpen || letterOpen) return;
  e.preventDefault(); if (!e.repeat) manualStart();
}, true);
addEventListener('keyup', e => {
  if (e.code !== 'Space') return;
  if (isOpen && !letterOpen) e.preventDefault();
  manualStop();
}, true);
addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeLetter(); });
$('pillHit').addEventListener('click', async () => {
  if (!micOn){ const ok = await startMic(); if (ok) return; }
  manualStart(); setTimeout(manualStop, 50);
});

/* ---------------- main loop ---------------- */
let last = performance.now();
function frame(now){
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000); last = now; const t = now / 1000;
  let strength = 0;
  if (micOn && analyser){
    const r = readMic(now);
    strength = r.strength;
    setMeter(micLevel);
    if (calibFrames < 15) status('listening…');
    else status(micBlowing ? 'blowing!' : 'listening…');
  }
  const manual = manualHeld || now < manualMinUntil;
  if (manual) strength = Math.max(strength, 0.75);
  const blowing = strength > 0 && isOpen && !letterOpen;

  F.forEach(f => {
    if (!f.lit) return;
    const flick = Math.sin(t * 9 + f.phase) * 0.6 + Math.sin(t * 17.3 + f.phase * 2) * 0.4;
    const target = blowing ? (14 + strength * (MAX_LEAN - 14)) * f.dir : 0;
    f.lean += (target - f.lean) * (blowing ? 0.28 : 0.12);
    const l = Math.abs(f.lean);
    const rot = flick * 1.6 + f.lean;
    const sy = 1 + flick * 0.03 - l * 0.006;
    const sx = 1 - flick * 0.02 - l * 0.003;
    f.fi.style.transform = `rotate(${rot.toFixed(2)}deg) scale(${sx.toFixed(3)},${sy.toFixed(3)})`;
    f.fi.style.opacity = (0.93 + flick * 0.07 - l * 0.004).toFixed(3);
    if (blowing) f.acc += dt * (0.6 + strength * 0.4) / (0.6 + 0.4);   // full-strength = real time
    else f.acc = Math.max(0, f.acc - dt * 0.8);
    if (f.acc >= f.need) extinguish(f);
  });
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);

/* ---------------- confetti ---------------- */
const cv = $('confetti'), cx = cv.getContext('2d');
let parts = [], confettiRAF = 0;
const COLORS = ['#4a86c8','#8fc3ee','#d6ecfb','#ffffff','#f6c85f','#ffb3c7','#6aa6e0','#c9b8ff'];
function sizeCanvas(){ const d = Math.min(2, devicePixelRatio || 1); cv.width = innerWidth * d; cv.height = innerHeight * d; cx.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0); }
addEventListener('resize', sizeCanvas); sizeCanvas();
function burstConfetti(){
  const W = innerWidth, H = innerHeight;
  const mk = (x, y, ang, spd) => ({
    x, y, vx: Math.cos(ang) * spd, vy: Math.sin(ang) * spd,
    w: 6 + Math.random() * 8, h: 4 + Math.random() * 7, rot: Math.random() * 6.28, vr: (Math.random() - .5) * 0.4,
    c: COLORS[(Math.random() * COLORS.length) | 0], shape: Math.random() < .25 ? 'star' : (Math.random() < .3 ? 'dot' : 'rect'),
    life: 0, max: 3.6 + Math.random() * 2.4, sway: Math.random() * 6.28
  });
  for (let i = 0; i < 90; i++){
    parts.push(mk(0, H * 0.9, -Math.PI / 2 + 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.7, 16 + Math.random() * 16));
    parts.push(mk(W, H * 0.9, -Math.PI / 2 - 0.2 - Math.random() * 0.7, 16 + Math.random() * 16));
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 90; i++){ const p = mk(Math.random() * W, -20 - Math.random() * H * 0.5, Math.PI / 2, 1 + Math.random() * 2); parts.push(p); }
  if (!confettiRAF) confettiRAF = requestAnimationFrame(tickConfetti);
}
function stopConfetti(){ parts = []; cx.clearRect(0, 0, innerWidth, innerHeight); if (confettiRAF){ cancelAnimationFrame(confettiRAF); confettiRAF = 0; } }
function star(c, r){ c.beginPath(); for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++){ const a = i * Math.PI / 5 - Math.PI / 2, rr = i % 2 ? r * .45 : r; c.lineTo(Math.cos(a) * rr, Math.sin(a) * rr); } c.closePath(); c.fill(); }
let cLast = 0;
function tickConfetti(now){
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - (cLast || now)) / 1000) * 60; cLast = now;
  cx.clearRect(0, 0, innerWidth, innerHeight);
  parts = parts.filter(p => p.life < p.max && p.y < innerHeight + 40);
  for (const p of parts){
    p.life += dt / 60; p.vy += 0.13 * dt; p.vx *= Math.pow(0.955, dt); p.vy *= Math.pow(0.955, dt);
    p.x += (p.vx + Math.sin(p.life * 4 + p.sway) * 0.8) * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.rot += p.vr * dt;
    cx.save(); cx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (p.max - p.life) * 1.2));
    cx.translate(p.x, p.y); cx.rotate(p.rot); cx.fillStyle = p.c;
    if (p.shape === 'rect') cx.fillRect(-p.w / 2, -p.h / 2, p.w, p.h * Math.abs(Math.cos(p.life * 6 + p.sway)) + 1);
    else if (p.shape === 'dot'){ cx.beginPath(); cx.arc(0, 0, p.h / 1.6, 0, 6.3); cx.fill(); }
    else star(cx, p.w * .8);
    cx.restore();
  }
  confettiRAF = parts.length ? requestAnimationFrame(tickConfetti) : 0;
  if (!parts.length){ cLast = 0; cx.clearRect(0, 0, innerWidth, innerHeight); }
}

// small read-only hook, handy for testing
window.__card = { get open(){ return isOpen; }, get letter(){ return letterOpen; }, get lit(){ return F.map(f => f.lit); },
  get lean(){ return F.map(f => f.lean); }, get mic(){ return micOn; }, get blowing(){ return micBlowing; }, get floor(){ return noiseFloor; }, get parts(){ return parts.length; } };
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
